title: Is Vince broken? First stats: S tier, #2 of 108 brawlers
description:
Is Vince broken? Yes 😳 After his first days he's S tier, #2 of 108 brawlers in trophy matches: 73.2% win rate vs 65.1% for the average brawler, from 114,491 battles. Not in competitive Ranked yet.

Best maps: Spiraling Out, Goldarm Gulch, Beach Ball, Time Flies, Local Restaurants.
Build most owners run: Bug Bandage, Metamothosis, Shield + Damage gears.
